chunks: Your Lord knows what is in your hearts. If you are righteous, then indeed He is forgiving to those who turn (in repentance).

key_terms.لِلْأَوَّابِينَ: to those who turn back (in repentance)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be Al-Awwabin in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the necessity of sincerity (ikhlas), distinguishing between mere outward compliance and the inner purity of the heart that Allah alone fully perceives. It highlights the spiritual station of 'Al-Awwabin' (the frequently returning), a trait highly valued in the Ahl al-Bayt, linking consistent repentance to divine mercy. This reinforces the concept that true righteousness is an internal state manifested through continuous return to the Divine.
